Summary: CAPITAL_EVENT_INVOLVES: admit capital events with confirmed counterparties as canonical relationships (type ratification, admission path, reachability)
Description: 1) Original intent: first additional relationship type produced from live evidence, so that capital events become admitted, evidence-grounded relationships that formation, temporal interpretation and synthesis can consume (decision record sections 3 and 7, step 3). 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) the Founder has recorded ratification of the type CAPITAL_EVENT_INVOLVES with the admission criteria of the decision record section 3 before any code adds it to the closed type set; (b) admission only when the source is an 8-K already classified as carrying a capital-event item, the event date, instrument (or equivalent), at least one named counterparty with a confirmed matching outcome (same entity confirmed or affiliation confirmed) and the supporting passage are present, and the evidence ladder step is at least supported connection; (c) magnitude recorded INDETERMINATE; (d) admission only through the single write path (admitAndProject), no second store; the in-memory canonical store is used until the durable store (step 4) exists; (e) counterparties without a confirmed match are shown as named in the filing, not admitted; (f) every admitted relationship carries accession, passage and the matching evidence and is shown with its evidence on Analysis and MAP; (g) two entities, one registry-resolved and one admitted at runtime, with a changed answer to a capital question; (h) existing suites green; the benchmark baseline is not altered. 3) Current implementation state: not built. The extractor, the evidence lines and the ratified-type machinery exist; the type does not. 4) Dependencies: the counterparty matching ticket (hard prerequisite: no admission before it returns confirmed outcomes); the Founder's ratification record for the type; the analytical snapshot (KRYL-1398, accepted) for inclusion; the durable store (step 4) for persistence. Shared-data gate applies to the ratified type list, the projection config and every reader of canonical relationships. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (closed type set, admitted relationships, evidence ladder). Status: opened 2026-10-11; blocked until the matching service exists and the ratification is recorded.
